name: Solo12-informed clean-room 12-DoF quadruped
attribution: Original Mujica primitive-geometry MJCF adapted from traceable ODRI Solo12 dimensions and mass properties; contains no copied upstream meshes, CAD, images, or source files

assumptions.statement: Hip locations and the 160 mm upper/lower link lengths follow the inspected Solo12 Xacro dimensions.
assumptions.validation: Compile the MJCF and compare authored joint/site transforms against the source dimensions.

assumptions.statement: Body and link masses and diagonal inertias are transcribed from the Solo12 Xacro; small off-diagonal inertia terms are omitted in this first clean-room model.
assumptions.validation: Compare aggregate mass and principal inertias, then replace the approximation only if dynamic sensitivity warrants it.

assumptions.statement: The 2.5 Nm action envelope follows the ODRI actuator module's documented 12 A output.
assumptions.validation: Keep the Runtime action clip at 2.5 Nm and test standing authority before changing the limit.

assumptions.statement: HAA is conservatively bounded inside the documented 215-degree standard range; HFE and KFE are limited to one bounded working revolution despite the hardware's multi-rotation capability and cable constraint.
assumptions.validation: Static studies must report joint margin in every required pose; hardware cable routing must be reviewed before widening limits.

assumptions.statement: Primitive torso, actuator-pod, link, and foot collision shapes conservatively represent the open hardware without copying its meshes.
assumptions.validation: Human visual review plus collision-free standing/fall Design Studies; later compare selected clearances against licensed CAD if exact assets are intentionally imported.

assumptions.statement: A 1 kHz implicit-fast integration step and elliptic contact cone are used as a conservative numerical baseline for the lightweight, low-inertia limbs.
assumptions.validation: Require a bounded home-stand probe and later run timestep/contact sensitivity before treating dynamic scores as architecture evidence.

assumptions.statement: A realistic 12-DoF architecture offers a more credible recovery mechanism than the demo fixture, but no self-righting capability is assumed.
assumptions.validation: Run identical static and readable-controller probes from left, right, front, and back resting poses.
